input.quote: On expiry or termination, Customer's right to access terminated subscription Services ends after any agreed transition period.
input.rationale: This is a hosted services agreement, but nothing obliges Vendor to provide exit assistance or to return Customer Data. Section 10.1 only ends access "after any agreed transition period" (no agreed period exists and no assistance obligation is created), Section 10.2 covers Deliverables and refunds only, and Section 16.5's return-or-destroy duty for Confidential Information expressly defers Customer Data to Sections 11 and 15, neither of which contains any export, return, or deletion-timing mechanic (Section 11 has no text; Section 15 addresses processing limits and privacy). The clause therefore fails even the fallback (90 days of assistance and a 30-day export), so we insert the preferred transition clause at Section 10.3: six months of assistance at then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days of any expiry or termination, and certified deletion after that return.

proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance and Customer Data return/deletion obligations in Section 10
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 10 winds down access but gives us no exit help or data return, so we have added our preferred transition clause: up to six months of assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days of any expiry or termination, and certified deletion after that return. We can fall back to 90 days of assistance with the same 30-day export if needed.

ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall (a) at Customer's request, provide transition assistance for up to six months at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty days after that expiry or termination, return all Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format; and (c) after that return, delete Customer Data from its systems and certify the deletion to Customer in writing.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
